INSERT INTO auth.accounts (id, user_id, provider_id, account_id, access_token, scope)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
         ON CONFLICT (provider_id, account_id) DO UPDATE
             SET access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token,
                 scope = EXCLUDED.scope,
                 updated_at = now()
